reason: Not refuted. All opcodes/modes are plain 6502 (CPX #imm, BCS, STY zp, JSR abs, LDA abs,Y, STA zp); no BBR/BBS/RMB/SMB. Bytes: CLC -1; LDY zp+JSR (5) -> LDA abs,Y+STA zp (5, mover_x_low is &F8) 0; LDA abs,X+BNE (5) -> CPX#+BCS (4) -1; JSR (3) -> STY zp+JSR (5, unused_0076 = &76) +2: net 0, so plot_mover_sprite &1AEA / leave_1f08 &1AFF / walk_column do not move; the new BCS sits where BNE leave_1f08 was (&1AD0, offset &2D), in range. Reads: movers_x_low &1344 + Y (Y <= &21) never crosses a page, the same read as get_mover_Y_x made. Cycles, y_offset <> 0 (every sprites_y_offset entry but &1C/&1D): CLC -2; JSR sub(6)+STY(3)+BEQ nt(2)+JMP(3)=14 -> STY(3)+JSR(6)=9, -5; LDY(3)+JSR(6)+LDA abs,Y(4)+STA(3)+LDA abs,Y(4)+STA(3)+RTS(6)=29 -> 7, -22; LDA abs,X(4)+BNE vs CPX#(2)+BCS, -2: 31, as claimed. Caveat for the claim, not the equivalence: with y_offset = 0 (sprites_y_offset &1C/&1D: type 9 frames 0-1, type 10 frame 0) the old BEQ path was 6+3+3+6 = 18 and the new runs rows_up's in-cell path (PHP 3, STA abs 4, AND 2, CMP zp 3, BCC 2, LDA abs 4, SBC zp 3, PLP 4, BRA 3, TAY 2, STZ 3, RTS 6 = 39) + STY 3 + JSR 6 = 48, +30, so that case is 4 cycles SLOWER overall (-26 + 30); the measured -29 a pass (vs 32 claimed) is consistent with that. Semantics checked: rows_up with unused_0076 = 0 gives C=1 at CMP, A = ru_lo - 0, PLP restores C/V as came, X untouched, Y = A (old Y = 0), unused_0076 0; walk_column reloads Y before use and plot_mover_sprite writes no flags before reading. Y = mover after plot_mover_sprite: walk_column opens LDY mover and none of its paths write Y. C = 0 before ADC #&1C: sum (frame AND &3F) + second offset <= 63 + &1E, no carry. &C5: not written by get_mover_sprite_and_screen_addresses, the clip loops, move_to_next_column_in_XY, walk_column or rows_up (ru_lo &0A9F, ru_d its own byte); the renderer's STA &C5 never runs inside plot_mover. CPX #5: mover_types_parts is 0 exactly for types 0-4 among the 28 types; exit flags C=1/Z differ but every tail-call chain checked (kill_mover's callers, move_and_replot_mover's 4598, update_mover whose C is dead, leave/enter helicopter into plot_player, consider_mover_firing_grenade) writes C/Z before reading.
